meta.title: PitLane v1.0 MVP Product Requirements Document

vision.statement: PitLane is the Formula 1 fantasy sports platform that enables passionate F1 fans to compete weekly in skill-based constructor drafts by selecting two drivers each race, unlike generic multi-sport fantasy apps which dilute the F1 experience with one-size-fits-all mechanics. Our north star is achieving 10,000 monthly active league members in the first full F1 season after launch.
vision.elevatorPitch: PitLane is a fantasy Formula 1 app where up to 11 players per league draft two drivers before each Grand Prix, score points based on race results, and compete for weekly wins and a season podium. It's the only fantasy platform built exclusively and deeply for F1, with automatic Jolpica-powered race data and unique per-race constructor drafts.

problemStatements.problem: No purpose-built F1 fantasy product with per-race drafting exists
problemStatements.currentWorkaround: Use ESPN/generic fantasy (season-long, wrong sport focus)

problemStatements.problem: Existing F1 fantasy apps (F1 official) lock users into season-long rosters with no weekly strategy
Private friend leagues with F1 scoring require manual spreadsheets
problemStatements.currentWorkaround: Google Sheets maintained by one person

problemStatements.problem: Race data availability is fragmented; no reliable free live results API

inScope: User auth & profiles (email registration, verification, username, default team name)
Season & race data sync (Jolpica integration, automatic import, admin override)
League management (create, join, invite, public/private, commissioner CRUD)
Per-race draft system (snake/regular draft, 24h timers, auto-draft, rotation)
Results & standings (weekly winners, season podium, live draft board)
Notification system (HTML5 push + email (SMTP), notification history)
Admin panel (data override, Jolpica sync management, user management)
DNF/DNS/DGE tracking (special stat tracking for double goose eggs)
outOfScope: Native iOS / Android apps (Web-first MVP strategy)
Multiple sports (Anti-scope creep; F1-only is the brand)
Live race telemetry / live scoring mid-race

personas.name: The Commissioner
personas.primaryGoal: Run a tight, fair fantasy league for his friend group
personas.painPoints: Manually updating spreadsheets after each race; chasing friends for picks; resolving scoring disputes
personas.jtbd: When race weekend approaches, I want to know everyone has submitted their picks and scores will update automatically, so I can focus on watching the race.

personas.name: The Active Drafter
personas.primaryGoal: Win her work league's season podium
personas.painPoints: Missing draft windows; not knowing driver standings; forgetting to set auto-draft
personas.jtbd: When it's my turn to draft, I want a clear notification and a ranked list of available drivers, so I can make a strategic pick quickly.

personas.name: The Admin
personas.primaryGoal: Ensure data integrity and system health with minimal manual intervention
personas.painPoints: Jolpica data delays after race; driver substitutions mid-season; commissioner escalations

coreFlows.name: Auto-Draft Execution
coreFlows.trigger: Draft window expires or preference set

coreFlows.name: Race Result Import
coreFlows.trigger: 3 hrs after race start, every 2 hrs

coreFlows.outcome: Override stored, audit trail created, commissioners notified

fia_official.description: Uses the actual FIA points system as of the current season

linear_20.description: 1st place = 20 points, each subsequent position earns 1 fewer point

technical.architecture: Modular Monolith — modules: auth, users, leagues, drafts, scoring, f1data, notifications, admin. Runtime: Node.js 20 LTS. API Style: REST + OpenAPI 3.1. Versioning: /api/v1/ prefix. WebSocket endpoint: /ws/leagues/{id}/draft
technical.prismaSchema: generator client { provider = "prisma-client-js" } datasource db { provider = "postgresql" url = env("DATABASE_URL") } // Full schema in PRD.md Section 12.2 with models: User, RefreshToken, VerificationToken, PushSubscription, EmailChangeRequest, Season, Race, Driver, RaceResult, DataDiscrepancy, DriverSubstitution, League, LeagueMember, LeagueMemberStat, DraftWindow, DraftPick, AutoDraftPreference, RaceScore, InviteLink, InviteLinkUse, JoinRequest, Notification, AuditLog, SystemSetting, CommissionerFlag

userStories.title: User Registration with Email Verification
userStories.description: Email-based registration with verification. Username defaults to email prefix. Password must meet complexity requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful registration creates user with status pending_verification
Clicking valid link within 24h sets status active and issues JWT
Password meets complexity rules (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special)
Duplicate email rejected with inline error
Invalid password disables Create Account button

userStories.title: User Login with Account Lockout
userStories.description: Email-based login with JWT tokens and account lockout after failed attempts.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid credentials return access token (15min TTL) and refresh token (30d TTL)
After 5 consecutive failed attempts, account locked for 15 minutes
Locked account shows lock message with unlock time
On 401 from authenticated endpoint, attempt refresh once
userStories.notes: JWT access token stored in memory, refresh token in httpOnly cookie

userStories.title: User Profile Management
userStories.description: Users can edit profile fields including username, display name, team name, notification preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Display name editable (1-50 chars, any UTF-8)
Password change requires current password confirmation
Email change triggers hold period flow

userStories.title: Email Change with Hold Period
userStories.description: Email change requires verification and configurable hold period for security.
acceptanceCriteria: User requests email change with current password confirmation
System sends notification to current email with cancel option
System sends verification email to new email
Change completes only when new email verified AND hold period elapsed (unless waived)
Current email holder can cancel change during hold period
Current email holder can waive hold for immediate change
Change expires if not completed within 72 hours
All refresh tokens invalidated on completion

userStories.title: Jolpica Data Import - Seasons and Races
userStories.description: Automated import of F1 seasons, races, circuits from Jolpica API.
acceptanceCriteria: Season data imported on app startup for current year
Races imported with round, raceName, Circuit, date, time
Driver data imported with driverId, permanentNumber, code, givenName, familyName, nationality, dateOfBirth
Race results polled starting 3 hours post-race-start
Polling every 2 hours, max 18 checks (36 hours total)
After 18 failed checks, trigger admin alert

userStories.title: Jolpica Race Results Import
userStories.description: Import race results from Jolpica with retry logic and admin fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Race results imported with position, Driver, Constructor, points, status, Time, FastestLap
Admin override fields preserved when Jolpica data differs
Data discrepancy records created for overridden fields
Score calculation triggered after successful import
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-02-23. Jolpica polling: HTTP 4xx = no retry (except 429), HTTP 5xx = retry after 2 hours

userStories.title: Admin Data Override
userStories.description: Admin interface to manually enter or override F1 data from Jolpica.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can override any field on race_results, driver_substitutions, race_schedule
Override stores jolpica_value, admin_value, admin_protected flag
All overrides trigger notification to league commissioners
All overrides logged in audit_log with before/after values

userStories.title: Create League
userStories.description: Commissioners can create leagues with configurable settings.
acceptanceCriteria: User who creates league becomes its commissioner
Commissioner can be commissioner of multiple leagues
User can be member of up to 10 leagues simultaneously
League name 3-80 chars, unique per season
Settings: scoring_type, draft_type, visibility, join_approval_required, target_players, max_players, missed_pick_resolution, substitution_policy
Commissioner can set/randomize draft order before first race
userStories.notes: League size: 2-11 players (22 F1 drivers ÷ 2). Completed 2026-02-23. Draft order randomization pending draft system implementation.

userStories.title: Join League
userStories.description: Users can join leagues via invite link or public search.
acceptanceCriteria: Public leagues: any authenticated user can join up to max_players
Private leagues: can only join via invite link
Invite links: 8-char random token, expire after 7 days, one-time use per user
Join approval required triggers pending request for commissioner
Team name prompted on join, unique within league (1-50 chars)
Cannot join mid-season after 3rd race completed
Users can leave league voluntarily at any time
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-02-23. Includes invite link system, join request approval flow, leave league, and member removal.

userStories.title: Commissioner League Management
userStories.description: Commissioners have full control over their league settings and members.
acceptanceCriteria: Commissioner can edit all league settings before first draft opens
scoring_type and draft_type locked after first draft
Commissioner can remove members (historical picks retained)
Commissioner can override draft pick resolution for edge cases
Commissioner can flag issues to platform admin
userStories.notes: Cannot modify historical race scores or picks directly

userStories.title: Draft Window Lifecycle
userStories.description: Per-race draft system with open/close rules and turn timers.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft window opens Monday 00:00 GMT of race week
Draft closes at qualifying start time OR when all players complete picks
Each player has 24 hours from turn start to make each pick
Draft closes automatically when all players submit both rounds
Late picks not accepted after qualifying start
Snake draft: Round 1 same as regular, Round 2 reverses
userStories.notes: Draft order rotation: after each race, position N moves to N+1, last moves to 1. Completed 2026-02-23. Draft window opens Monday of race week, closes at qualifying start. 24h turn timer implemented. Snake and regular draft both supported.

userStories.title: Draft Pick Submission
userStories.description: Players submit driver picks during their turn in the draft window.
acceptanceCriteria: Driver already picked by another player in same league unavailable
Drivers displayed with name, team, season points, last race position
Pick validation: driver available, player's turn, window open
Pick submission broadcasts via WebSocket to all league members
Turn advances to next player after pick

userStories.title: Auto-Draft Preference Queue
userStories.description: Players can pre-rank drivers for automatic selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Players can set weighted preference list during open draft window
Preference list is ordered (1 = highest preference)
Auto-draft fires immediately on turn start (not after 24h wait)
If all ranked drivers taken, system treats as no auto-draft (24h timer begins)
Players can update preference list before auto-pick fires
Auto-draft picks logged as resolution_method = auto_preference
userStories.notes: Players do not need to rank all 22 drivers

userStories.title: Driver Substitution After Draft Lock
userStories.description: Handle IRL driver substitutions that occur after draft window closes.
acceptanceCriteria: Substitution BEFORE draft closes: replacement added to pool, original unavailable
Substitution AFTER draft closes: player notified immediately
redraft policy: player gets one-time re-pick from remaining (24h window)
auto_replace policy: replacement driver automatically assigned
System waits for Jolpica/admin confirmation before acting
DNS (no substitute) after draft lock: player scores 0 for that slot
All substitution events logged in driver_substitutions table

userStories.title: Missed Pick Resolution
userStories.description: Resolve picks when player fails to submit within 24-hour timer.
acceptanceCriteria: top_points: Assign available driver with highest season championship points (random if tied)
no_pick: Player gets no driver, scores 0 for that slot
Player notified when pick expires and resolution applied
userStories.notes: Missed pick resolution commissioner-configurable per league

userStories.title: Scoring Engine - FIA Official
userStories.description: Calculate scores using FIA official points system.
acceptanceCriteria: Fastest lap bonus (+1) if driver finishes in top 10
Player race score = Driver 1 score + Driver 2 score
DNF rule: any non-Finished status scores 0
userStories.notes: FIA scoring table admin-editable for rule changes. Completed 2026-02-23. Also implemented linear_20 and proprietary scoring systems.

userStories.title: Scoring Engine - Linear 20-Point
userStories.description: Calculate scores using linear 20-point system.
acceptanceCriteria: Each position after 1st earns 1 fewer point (20th = 1)
Player race score = Driver 1 score + Driver 2 score
userStories.notes: Implemented together with US-016. LINEAR_20_SCORING_TABLE in types.ts.

userStories.title: Scoring Engine - Proprietary
userStories.description: Calculate scores using proprietary 10th=10pts system (default).
acceptanceCriteria: Each position further from 10th earns 1 fewer point
Minimum 1 point for any finisher except DNF/DNS/DSQ/no driver
Player race score = Driver 1 score + Driver 2 score
userStories.notes: Implemented together with US-016. PROPRIETARY_SCORING_TABLE in types.ts.

userStories.title: Double Goose Egg (DGE) Tracking
userStories.description: Track and display DGE occurrences (both drivers score 0).
acceptanceCriteria: DGE occurs when BOTH drafted drivers score 0 points
DGE only applies to actual drivers, not no_pick
dge_count persisted per player per league across season
Displayed prominently in standings as DGE count
Admin overrides retroactively recalculate DGE stats

userStories.title: Weekly Winners & Season Podium
userStories.description: Track and display weekly winners and season standings.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly winner: highest race score for given race
Season podium: top 3 cumulative season points
Season standings updated after each race result scored
Season ends after final race of F1 season
Historical seasons preserved in read-only state
userStories.notes: All historical picks/scores visible to all league members

userStories.title: League Standings View
userStories.epic: EPIC-006 — Standings, Stats & Live Draft Board
userStories.description: Display season standings and race history to league members.
acceptanceCriteria: Season standings table: rank, team name, username, total points, weekly wins, DGE count
Race-by-race history: expandable rows showing picks, scores, weekly winner
Current week: draft status, who has picked, timer remaining
All historical data visible to all members
Public visibility controlled by commissioner setting
userStories.notes: Visibility: public or private controlled by commissioner

userStories.title: Live Draft Board (WebSocket)
userStories.epic: EPIC-006 — Standings, Stats & Live Draft Board
userStories.description: Real-time draft board with WebSocket updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Current pick order displayed (who is up, who is next)
Timer countdown for active player's 24h window
Already-drafted drivers per player per round
Real-time updates as picks submitted (<500ms latency)
On disconnect: show banner, fall back to 10s polling

userStories.notes: Works on desktop and mobile web

userStories.title: Email Notifications via SMTP

userStories.title: In-App Notification Center

userStories.title: Draft Event Notifications

fullSpecReference: PitLane MVP: F1 fantasy platform with per-race drafting. Key features: (1) Email auth with verification, (2) Jolpica API integration for F1 data, (3) League management (2-11 players), (4) Snake/regular draft system with 24h timers, (5) 3 scoring systems (FIA, linear 20, proprietary 10th=10pts), (6) Weekly winners & season podium, (7) HTML5 push + email notifications, (8) Admin panel with data override. Tech stack: Next.js 15, Fastify 5, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Prisma 5, TypeScript 5. API: REST + OpenAPI 3.1, WebSocket for live draft. Target: Q2 2026 launch, 500 MAU by end of 2026 season.
